name: Respect blocking Story links before worker launch
description:
Factory review recommendation 12 of 20.

## Context

Story Linking is enabled, but the supervisor can launch a Story whose blocking Story is unfinished.

## Acceptance criteria

- Expose unresolved blocking Stories in factory eligibility or Stage Run output.
- Skip launch while blocking Stories remain unfinished and report the reason clearly.
- Reconsider eligibility when the blocking Story reaches Done.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.
